This success highlights the film's strong audience connection and appeal.
title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office day 34: India net reaches Rs 153.13 cr

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Tabu boasts a three-decade acting career with diverse roles and significant earnings.  She owns a luxurious Hyderabad bungalow and a Mumbai apartment.  Her impressive car collection includes luxury models and a classic Mustang.  Tabu began her film journey in 1985 and has since appeared in about ninety films.  She will reprise her role as Meera Deshmukh in 'Drishyam: The Conclusion' releasing October 2, 2026.
title: Tabu net worth: Actress owns lavish Hyd bungalow with personal gym & fish pond

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Masked protesters wrongly gathered outside a Portsmouth hotel expecting asylum seekers. They later learned the hotel housed Pakistan's Under-19 cricket team members. A local councillor clarified the misunderstanding, and the protesters departed quickly. This incident occurred amid rising tensions following asylum seeker arrivals in the city. The England and Wales Cricket Board is reviewing security for the visiting team.
title: Masked protesters mistake Pak U-19 cricket team for asylum seekers in Portsmouth

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Wild Card’s “Rewild the Ghost Woods” campaign has secured £5.9 million in government funding to restore 105,000 acres of ancient woodland sites buried beneath conifer plantations. The 2026–2029 funding aims to accelerate restoration across Forestry England’s estate, with Nature Minister Mary Creagh confirming a target to double the recent restoration rate.
title: £5.9M project to revive England's 105,000-acre 'Ghost Woods'

author: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA
description: The National Investigation Agency filed a charge sheet detailing the Red Fort vehicle-borne IED attack.  The bomber initially targeted Lal Mandir but was diverted by traffic and police presence.  He detonated the explosive near Red Fort Gate No. 4, killing eleven people.  The device was triggered remotely using a mechanism fitted into the bomber's shoe.  This attack was the first vehicle-borne IED incident reported in the national capital.
title: ‘Lal Mandir was original target’: How traffic forced Red Fort bomber to change plans

description: Mallya, who is living in London, made the remarks while responding to the legal proceedings against him and defending his position on the recovery of money owed to banks by his now-defunct Kingfisher Airlines. description: The remarkable friendship between Sophie Cunningham and Caitlin Clark blossomed during the 2024 WNBA All-Star Game, solidifying when they became teammates on the Indiana Fever. description: A social media post sparked rumors about Christopher Nolan directing a Game of Thrones movie. The film, titled Aegon's Conquest, is confirmed by Warner Bros. for future release. Beau Willimon is writing the script, focusing on Aegon the Conqueror's reign. Fans reacted with humor to the possibility of Nolan's involvement. The movie will explore Targaryen history and the unification of Westeros.

description: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups box office collections continue to decline. The film earned sixty lakhs on its fifteenth day of release. Its total India net collection has now reached two hundred forty-seven point eighty-five crores. Worldwide gross collection stands at three hundred thirty-nine point thirty-two crores. The Kannada version led the film's India net collection on Day 15.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An £8.28 million Grade II-listed Cotswolds mansion has suffered extensive damage after an electrical fire tore through the historic property. Barton House, a 17th-century manor near Guiting Power, was bought by a private owner in January 2025. The owners said they were “in so much shock” as firefighters battled the blaze for nearly 12 hours.
title: £8.28M Cotswolds mansion gutted by fire months after sale

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Gaur Gopal Das highlights the importance of small, consistent actions in achieving lasting success. He warns that ignoring tiny tasks can foster bad habits. By mastering these seemingly minor details, one cultivates discipline and preparation for larger responsibilities. This principle resonates in various fields, ranging from medical practices to aviation. Ultimately, a focus on daily minutiae fosters continuous growth and paves the way for substantial accomplishments.
title: Gaur Gopal Das Quote: Small daily actions build discipline; big wins follow slowly

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: As Afghanistan prepare to face India in a three-match T20I series, starting Sunday at the Arun Jaitley Stadium in Delhi, star all-rounder Rashid Khan opened up about the challenges he faced as a child in the war-torn country and how those experiences helped shape his mindset.
title: 'A ball won't kill you, but bullets can': Rashid Khan on childhood in Afghanistan

description: Brazil's new coach Carlo Ancelotti has named a 26-player squad for upcoming matches.  The team will face Australia twice in September and then India.  This selection marks a significant reshaping of the national team after their World Cup exit.  Ancelotti is looking to integrate young talent for future tournaments.  Brazil aims to rebuild its strength and challenge for the next World Cup.
title: Brazil vs India: Vinicius Jr, Raphinha set for historic Kolkata showdown

author: RAJESH KUMAR PANDEY
description: The Allahabad High Court criticized Deoria police officials for alleged illegal detention.  The court expressed disappointment over missing CCTV footage from the police station.  It directed the UP government to pay Rs 65,000 to the four petitioners.  The court noted that actions were taken after the petition was filed.  The bench questioned the release of full payment for the CCTV system.
title: ‘Bunch of liars’: Allahabad HC raps UP cops over illegal detention
